lunar.title: Fish Activity Calendar
lunar.subtitle: Moon phases and solunar times
lunar.solunarInfo: Solunar theory predicts when fish are most active based on the position of the moon and sun. Major periods occur during moon transits, minor periods during moonrise/moonset.

winterColdNight.fish: Night + Cold: Whiting active in deep waters. Sea bass hunting near rocky bottoms. Scorpionfish searching for bottom creatures.
winterColdNight.bait: Phosphorescent jig head (21-28gr), orange/red silicone, live squid pieces, glow shad for night

winterColdMorning.fish: Morning + Cold: Whiting and Sea bass starting morning activity. Turbot in sandy bottom areas. Ideal for bottom fishing.
winterColdMorning.bait: Heavy silicone (motor oil color), 18-25gr jig head, live baitfish, slow pitch jig

winterColdCalm.fish: Calm winter day: Whiting schools gathered at bottom. Sea bass moving slowly. Turbot may be active.
winterColdCalm.bait: Deep minnow (11-14cm), heavy metal jig, live bait preferred

winterColdWindy.fish: Cold + Windy: Sea bass approaching shore, bait organisms near coastline. Whiting waiting in deep waters.
winterColdWindy.bait: Heavy jig head (21-28gr), large silicone fish, deep running minnow, live bait

winterStorm.fish: Winter storm: Sea bass and Mullet in sheltered harbors. Scorpionfish at breakwater bottoms.
winterStorm.bait: Heavy silicone, live bait essential, bread for mullet, live baitfish

winterCoolMorning.fish: Ideal winter morning: Sea bass on morning hunt, Whiting active, Sea bream in deep waters. Golden hour!
winterCoolMorning.bait: 11-14cm suspending minnow, silicone shad (motor oil), live bream, slow jig

winterCoolEvening.fish: Winter evening: Sea bass in evening activity, Dentex on rocks, Red porgy in deep reefs.
winterCoolEvening.bait: Minnow (natural colors), medium weight jig, live shrimp, squid pieces

winterCoolNight.fish: Winter night: Sea bass night fishing amazing! Whiting showing interest in phosphorescent lures. Check around lights.
winterCoolNight.bait: Phosphorescent silicone, glow minnow, live bait, scan around lanterns

winterCoolMid.fish: Winter midday: Sea bass and Whiting active. Sea bream in deep areas. Patience required.
winterCoolMid.bait: Minnow, silicone shad, try live bait combination

winterCoolWindy.fish: Windy winter: Sea bass very active on shores! Wind pushing bait to coast. Don't miss the chance!
winterCoolWindy.bait: Deep running minnow, heavy jig head (14-21gr), large silicone fish

winterCoolStorm.fish: Stormy winter: Sea bass, Mullet and Scorpionfish in sheltered harbors. Breakwaters productive.
winterCoolStorm.bait: Heavy silicone, live bait, bread (for mullet), breakwater bottoms

winterMildCalm.fish: Mild winter day: Sea bass, Sea bream, Dentex very active! Bluefish occasionally seen. Mid-winter surprise!
winterMildCalm.bait: 11-14cm minnow (natural colors), stick bait, popper, live horse mackerel

winterMildWindy.fish: Mild and windy winter: Sea bass on rocks, Sea bream at current spots, Mullet on shores.
winterMildWindy.bait: Minnow, silicone, bread for mullet, target current areas

springCoolMorning.fish: Spring morning: Sea bass waking up, Sea bream seeking warm water, Bluefish approaching shores!
springCoolMorning.bait: Minnow (bright colors), silicone shad, popper, live baitfish

springCoolEvening.fish: Spring evening: Sea bass active in evening hunt, Bluefish in schools, Dentex on rocks.
springCoolEvening.bait: Stick bait, popper, metal jig 20-30gr, live horse mackerel

springCoolMid.fish: Spring midday: Sea bass, Sea bream active. Bluefish starting to appear. Season opening!
springCoolMid.bait: Minnow, silicone, try popper, live bait always works

springCoolWindy.fish: Windy spring: Sea bass and Bluefish very active on shores! Wind bringing bait.
springCoolWindy.bait: Heavy minnow, metal jig, large silicone, try surface lures

springCoolStorm.fish: Stormy spring: Sea bass, Mullet in sheltered areas. After storm is golden!
springCoolStorm.bait: Heavy jig, live bait, wait for after the storm

springIdealMorning.fish: GOLDEN MORNING! Sea bass, Sea bream, Bluefish, Bonito all active! Best time of the season!
springIdealMorning.bait: Any lure works: minnow, popper, jig, live bait. Action guaranteed!

springIdealEvening.fish: GOLDEN EVENING! Bluefish attacking in schools, Sea bass on rocks, Bonito on surface!
springIdealEvening.bait: Popper, stick bait, metal jig, sabiki rig, live horse mackerel

springIdealNight.fish: Spring night: Sea bass night fishing spectacular, Squid season opened, Red mullet active.
springIdealNight.bait: Phosphorescent minnow, squid jig (egi), live shrimp, night jig

springIdealMid.fish: Perfect spring: ALL FISH ACTIVE! Sea bass, Sea bream, Bluefish, Dentex, Red porgy...
springIdealMid.bait: Minnow, popper, jig, live bait - try everything!

springIdealWindy.fish: Windy but productive: Bluefish going crazy! Sea bass close to shore. Bonito in schools.
springIdealWindy.bait: Metal jig 30-50gr, large popper, trolling lure, sabiki

springIdealStorm.fish: Strong wind: Great for Bluefish and Bonito! Sea bass very active on shore!
springIdealStorm.bait: Heavy metal jig, large silicone, deep minnow

springWarmCalm.fish: Pre-summer: Sea bream, Horse mackerel, Chub mackerel active. Bluefish better at night. Red porgy in depths.
springWarmCalm.bait: Small minnow (7-9cm), micro jig, sabiki, live shrimp

springWarmWindy.fish: Hot and windy: Surface fish (Bluefish, Horse mackerel, Chub mackerel) active. Fish morning/evening.
springWarmWindy.bait: Popper, small metal jig, sabiki rig, stick bait

summerMildNight.fish: Golden summer night: Sea bass active at night, Squid fishing ideal, Red porgy and Comber at bottom.
summerMildNight.bait: Phosphorescent silicone, squid jig (egi), night minnow, live shrimp

summerMildMorning.fish: Early summer morning: Sea bass at sunrise, Sea bream doesn't like heat - fish early!
summerMildMorning.bait: Minnow, silicone, popper - finish before sun rises

summerMildEvening.fish: Summer evening: Sea bass, Bluefish, Horse mackerel activating with temperature drop. Fish evenings!
summerMildEvening.bait: Popper, stick bait, minnow, live bait

summerMildMidday.fish: Hot midday: Fish retreating to deep, cool waters. Midday fishing difficult.
summerMildMidday.bait: Deep jig, live bait, target shaded areas

summerMildWindy.fish: Windy summer: Horse mackerel, Chub mackerel, Bluefish on surface! Sea breeze time!
summerMildWindy.bait: Sabiki, popper, metal jig, live smelt

summerHotNight.fish: Hot summer night: NIGHT FISHING ESSENTIAL! Sea bass, Squid, Red mullet, Red porgy active at night.
summerHotNight.bait: Any phosphorescent lure, squid egi, live shrimp, night jig

summerHotMorning.fish: Hot morning: Only 1-2 hours before sunrise! Fish go deeper after that.
summerHotMorning.bait: Fish fast - minnow, popper, live bait

summerHotMidday.fish: Very hot day: Midday fishing very difficult. Night or very early morning only chance.
summerHotMidday.bait: Deep water lures, live bait, plan for night fishing

summerHotWindy.fish: Hot but windy: Horse mackerel, Chub mackerel schools on surface. Bluefish may come out in evening.
summerHotWindy.bait: Sabiki, micro jig, popper, wait for evening

summerVeryHotNight.fish: Scorching night: Night fishing only option! Sea bass, Squid, bottom fish active.
summerVeryHotNight.bait: Full phosphorescent gear, squid egi, live bait

summerVeryHotDay.fish: Extreme heat: Fishing very difficult. Prefer night fishing or go to very deep waters.
summerVeryHotDay.bait: Deep water jig, live bait, wait for night

autumnEarlyMorning.fish: Golden autumn morning: Bluefish in frenzy! Bonito schools! Sea bass on rocks!
autumnEarlyMorning.bait: Metal jig, popper, minnow, sabiki - everything works!

autumnEarlyEvening.fish: Spectacular autumn evening: Bluefish in attack mode, Bonito ideal for trolling, Sea bass active!
autumnEarlyEvening.bait: Popper, stick bait, trolling lure, metal jig 30-50gr

autumnEarlyMid.fish: AUTUMN SEASON! Bluefish, Bonito, Sea bass, Sea bream - most productive time of year!
autumnEarlyMid.bait: Any artificial lure, live horse mackerel, sabiki, trolling lure

autumnEarlyWindy.fish: Windy autumn: Bluefish and Bonito going crazy! Sea bass gone wild on shore!
autumnEarlyWindy.bait: Heavy jig, large popper, trolling, large minnow

autumnCoolMorning.fish: Cool autumn morning: Sea bass, Sea bream main activity time. Bluefish still around. Whiting arriving!
autumnCoolMorning.bait: Minnow (11-14cm), silicone shad, live baitfish, jig

autumnCoolEvening.fish: Autumn evening: Sea bass evening exit amazing, Bluefish last attacks, Dentex on rocks.
autumnCoolEvening.bait: Stick bait, popper, minnow, live horse mackerel

autumnCoolMid.fish: Cool autumn day: Sea bass and Sea bream very active. Bluefish decreasing. Whiting increasing.
autumnCoolMid.bait: Minnow, silicone, live bait - classic gear

autumnCoolWindy.fish: Windy autumn: Sea bass stuck to shore! Attacks anything that moves!
autumnCoolWindy.bait: Large silicone, heavy minnow, live bait

autumnColdCalm.fish: Late autumn: Whiting season opened! Sea bass retreating to deep waters. Turbot active.
autumnColdCalm.bait: Heavy jig, deep minnow, live bait, slow pitch jig

autumnColdWindy.fish: Cold and windy autumn: Good for Whiting and Sea bass! Winter preparation started.
autumnColdWindy.bait: Heavy silicone, jig head 18-25gr, live baitfish

morning.fish: Morning hours: Sea bass, Sea bream, Bluefish expected to be active. Golden hour!
morning.bait: Minnow, silicone, popper - classic morning gear

evening.fish: Evening hours: Fish coming out for dinner. Sea bass, Bluefish, Horse mackerel active.
evening.bait: Popper, stick bait, minnow - ideal for evening

night.fish: Night fishing: Sea bass, Squid, Red mullet active at night. Check around lights.
night.bait: Phosphorescent lures, squid egi, live shrimp

default.fish: General conditions: Sea bass, Sea bream, Bluefish, Horse mackerel may be active. Fish according to conditions.
default.bait: 11-14cm minnow, silicone fish, popper, metal jig - variety is key

newMoon.title: New Moon - BEST PERIOD!

night.fish: GOLDEN NIGHT FISHING! Sea bass, Sea bream, Bluefish hunting in darkness. Squid very active!
night.tip: Total darkness - fish feel safe and come to surface. Phosphorescent lures essential!

day.fish: New moon daytime: Sea bass, Sea bream in deep waters. Wait for evening and night!
day.tip: Daytime activity low. Plan for night fishing. Fish very early morning or evening.

newMoon.bait: Phosphorescent silicone, glow minnow, live bait, squid egi

waxingCrescent.title: Waxing Crescent - Good Period

night.fish: High night activity: Sea bass, Whiting, Sea bream active. Low light is advantage!
night.tip: Little moonlight - fish still have night advantage. Morning and evening also good.

day.fish: Daytime: Sunrise and sunset most productive. Sea bass on rocks.
day.tip: Little moonlight - fish still have night advantage. Morning and evening also good.

waxingCrescent.bait: Natural color minnow, silicone shad, live baitfish, medium weight jig

firstQuarter.title: First Quarter - Medium Activity

night.fish: Sea bream, Horse mackerel, Red mullet at medium activity. Sea bass feeding selectively.
night.tip: Early morning hours more productive. Evening activity may decrease. Patience required.

day.fish: Sea bream, Horse mackerel, Red mullet at medium activity. Sea bass feeding selectively.
day.tip: Early morning hours more productive. Evening activity may decrease. Patience required.

firstQuarter.bait: Small minnow, sabiki, live shrimp, prefer natural colors

waxingGibbous.title: Approaching Full Moon - Increasing Activity

night.fish: Sea bass, Bluefish, Chub mackerel starting to activate! Full moon preparation.
night.tip: Getting better each day! Evening hours increasingly productive. Prepare for night fishing.

day.fish: Sea bass, Bluefish, Chub mackerel starting to activate! Full moon preparation.
day.tip: Getting better each day! Evening hours increasingly productive. Prepare for night fishing.

waxingGibbous.bait: Popper, stick bait, metal jig, bright colors effective

fullMoon.title: FULL MOON - PEAK ACTIVITY!

night.fish: NIGHT FISHING SPECTACULAR! ALL FISH on surface in moonlight! Schools visible!
night.tip: Moonlight illuminating the sea - fish feeding comfortably. Silver/white lures!

day.fish: Full moon daytime: Activity still high. Can fish all day!
day.tip: Full moon effect continues during day. Evening and night even better!

fullMoon.bait: Surface lures, popper, silver/white minnow, bright jig, live bait

waningGibbous.title: After Full Moon - Still Very Good

night.fish: Night still productive: Sea bass, Sea bream, Bonito active. Moonlight decreasing.
night.tip: Full moon effect lasts 2-3 days. Night fishing still recommended.

day.fish: Daytime good: Morning especially productive. Activity continues.
day.tip: Full moon effect lasts 2-3 days. Night fishing still recommended.

waningGibbous.bait: Minnow, silicone, trolling lure, live horse mackerel

lastQuarter.title: Last Quarter - Decreasing Activity

night.fish: Whiting, Red mullet, Scorpionfish (bottom fish) coming forward. Surface activity low.
night.tip: Bottom fishing more productive. Early morning hours. Target deep waters.

day.fish: Whiting, Red mullet, Scorpionfish (bottom fish) coming forward. Surface activity low.
day.tip: Bottom fishing more productive. Early morning hours. Target deep waters.

lastQuarter.bait: Heavy jig, live bait, squid pieces, bottom rigs

waningCrescent.title: Waning Crescent - New Moon Preparation

night.fish: Darkness increasing: Sea bass, Whiting starting to activate at night!
night.tip: Activity starting to increase. Prepare for night fishing! New Moon approaching.

day.fish: Daytime slow: Activity low. Wait for New Moon or fish at night.
day.tip: Activity starting to increase. Prepare for night fishing! New Moon approaching.

waningCrescent.bait: Phosphorescent lures, deep minnow, silicone, night gear
